results.title: Departed PI transfer to verified co-owner with full notice
recommendedActions: Approve the ownership transfer and retain the succession receipt.

results.title: Contributor attempts takeover without independent approval

findings.message: The packet does not show a valid owner inactivity, departure, or succession trigger.
findings.remediation: Require owner consent or document a valid inactivity, departure, death, suspension, or institutional succession trigger.

findings.message: The proposed owner lacks a succession-eligible project role.
findings.remediation: Limit ownership succession to admins, co-owners, PIs, data stewards, or institutional stewards.

findings.message: The proposed owner does not have current verified identity and MFA evidence.
findings.remediation: Require fresh identity verification and MFA before ownership transfer.

findings.message: Ownership transfer lacks an independent institutional, data-steward, quorum, or legal approval path.
findings.remediation: Route the packet to an institutional steward, data steward plus co-owner quorum, or documented legal authority.

findings.message: Not all collaborators were notified about the ownership succession request.
findings.remediation: Notify all active collaborators and preserve the notice receipt in the audit log.

findings.message: The collaborator objection window is too short for a project ownership transfer.
findings.remediation: Provide at least a 14-day objection window unless legal or safety escalation documents an exception.

findings.message: The transfer packet does not preserve original owner credit, contribution history, and a public transfer receipt.
findings.remediation: Preserve original PI/owner credit, contribution records, and a public audit receipt for the transfer reason.

findings.message: The transfer has an unresolved ownership dispute or competing successor claim.
findings.remediation: Hold the transfer until the dispute is resolved by independent governance.

findings.message: The succession packet lacks an immutable audit receipt.
findings.remediation: Record the trigger, approvals, notices, object freezes, and attribution preservation in an immutable audit receipt.

recommendedActions: Freeze owner-only project actions until the succession packet is resolved.
Route the packet to independent governance review.
Preserve original owner attribution and collaborator notice evidence.

results.title: Clinical dataset project transfer missing compliance signoff

findings.message: The project has regulated-data, IRB, DUA, embargo, clinical, or export-control holds without compliance approval.
findings.remediation: Require compliance-officer approval and keep restricted objects frozen until the transfer is approved.

recommendedActions: Keep regulated datasets and embargoed artifacts locked until compliance approval is recorded.
Freeze owner-only project actions until the succession packet is resolved.
Route the packet to independent governance review.
Preserve original owner attribution and collaborator notice evidence.
